subject.title: fix(doctor): skip cleanup hints for active gateway and downgrade exec SecretRef errors to warnings

question: Should doctor be allowed to downgrade exec SecretRef failures through the exported strict SecretRef helper and a process-wide env flag, or should lenient handling stay in a doctor-only read-only inspection path?
rationale: This changes a CODEOWNERS-protected SecretRef boundary and generated plugin SDK surface, so a maintainer/security owner should confirm the permanent contract before merge.

options.title: Keep strict helper strict
options.body: Use a doctor-only inspection path, such as the current resolveSecretInputString configured-unavailable mode, so runtime and plugin strict callers keep throwing on unresolved SecretRefs.

options.title: Approve doctor-wide leniency
options.body: Accept the process-wide doctor mode only with explicit secops approval, public API documentation, and tests proving non-doctor strict behavior remains unchanged.

options.title: Split the fixes
options.body: Land the gateway cleanup-hint fix separately and defer SecretRef behavior to a narrower security-owned PR.

recommendation.title: Keep strict helper strict
recommendation.body: Use a doctor-only inspection path, such as the current resolveSecretInputString configured-unavailable mode, so runtime and plugin strict callers keep throwing on unresolved SecretRefs.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh authored the current SecretRef inspect/strict contract that this PR changes.
